facts.S_SM: Each settlement asset independently supports its own instruments; requirements summed per asset. Idle USDC cannot automatically satisfy BTC or ETH inverse requirements.
facts.X_SM: Cross-collateral mode combines supported assets, with haircuts/collateral fees; exact rules require unread specification.
facts.PM: Scenario portfolio methodology differs from SM. Cross PM recognizes within-asset hedges, not cross-asset risk netting.
facts.equity: cash balance + sum futures UPL/RPL + option values
facts.SM_IM: sum position IM plus open-order IM
facts.pre_expiry_transition: During last30min, IM/MM converge to projected IM/MM excluding nearest-expiry instruments.
